title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Agreement with Simmons College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure of the letter and attachments filed on September 25, 2001. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-17)
